column2: Check that the Splash Screen is displayed immediately after application launch on both iOS and Android devices.
Check that the Splash Screen is displayed as a full-screen view with a white background covering the entire device screen.
Check that the Concert Technologies logo is displayed centered both vertically and horizontally on the Splash Screen.
Check that the logo on the Splash Screen is static and does not include any animation or loading indicator.
Check that no text labels, buttons, links, or input fields are displayed on the Splash Screen.
Check that the system status bar (time, network, battery) is visible while the Splash Screen is displayed.
Check that no user interaction is possible on the Splash Screen, including taps, swipes, or system back actions.
Check that the application validates an existing user session in the background while the Splash Screen is displayed.
Check that the application verifies the authentication token status during the Splash Screen initialization phase.
Check that essential application configuration and metadata are loaded while the Splash Screen is visible.
Check that the application automatically navigates to the Login Screen after the Splash Screen if no valid user session exists.
Check that the application automatically navigates to the Home / Jobs List or Calendar Screen after the Splash Screen if a valid user session exists.
Check that the transition from the Splash Screen to the next screen occurs automatically without visible delays or technical artifacts.
Check that the Splash Screen is displayed for the minimum required time needed to complete initialization without unnecessary prolongation.
Check that the Splash Screen handles slow initialization gracefully without visual glitches, flickering, or layout shifts.
Check that the Welcome Screen is displayed as a full-screen view when the application is opened by a non-authenticated user.
Check that the Welcome Screen is not displayed when a valid user session token exists and the app navigates directly to the Home / Jobs screen.
Check that no navigation bar or back button is displayed on the Welcome Screen.
Check that the header text “Welcome to the Concert Technologies” is displayed and centered on the Welcome Screen.
Check that the subtext “Create an account or log in to get started.” is displayed below the header text.
Check that the Welcome Screen layout remains visually centered and consistent across different screen sizes and orientations.
Check that the “Sign up” button is displayed as the primary (filled) call-to-action at the bottom of the Welcome Screen.
Check that the “Login” button is displayed as the secondary (outlined or neutral) call-to-action below the “Sign up” button.
Check that tapping the “Sign up” button navigates the user to the Account Registration / Sign Up screen.
Check that tapping the “Login” button navigates the user to the Login screen.
Check that multiple rapid taps on the “Sign up” button do not trigger multiple navigation events.
Check that multiple rapid taps on the “Login” button do not trigger multiple navigation events.

column2: Check that navigation from the Welcome Screen to the Sign Up screen completes successfully without visual glitches or delays.
Check that navigation from the Welcome Screen to the Login screen completes successfully without visual glitches or delays.
Check that a generic error message is displayed if navigation to the Sign Up screen fails and the user is allowed to retry.
General & Layout
Check that the Registration screen is displayed when the user taps “Sign up” from the Welcome screen.
Check that the Registration screen displays the logo, title “Registration”, and subtitle “Good to see you! Let’s get you registered.”
Check that the Registration screen displays input fields in the following order: First name, Last name, Phone number, Email.
Check that the Registration screen displays the “Preferred channel for job notifications” section below the Email field.
Check that the Registration screen displays SMS and Email radio button options in the notification channel section.
Check that the Registration screen displays the SMS consent checkbox and disclaimer text below the preferred notification channel section.
Check that the Continue button is disabled by default when required fields are empty.
Check that the Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions links are displayed below the Continue button.
Check that the “Already have an account? Log in” link is displayed at the bottom of the Registration screen.
Check that the Registration screen layout remains correctly aligned on different screen sizes and orientations.
First Name / Last Name Validation
Check that the First name field is required on the Registration screen.
Check that the Last name field is required on the Registration screen.
Check that inline validation is displayed if the First name field is empty after validation is triggered.
Check that inline validation is displayed if the Last name field is empty after validation is triggered.
Check that the First name field accepts alphabetical characters only.
Check that the Last name field accepts alphabetical characters only.
Check that invalid characters are rejected in the First name and Last name fields.
Check that validation messages are cleared dynamically after correcting invalid First name or Last name values.
Phone Number Field & Country Selector
Check that the Phone number field is required on the Registration screen.
Check that the Phone number field displays the selected country code prefix.
Check that tapping the country code selector opens the country selection bottom sheet.
Check that the country selection bottom sheet displays country flags, country names, and dialing codes.
Check that the country search field filters countries dynamically while typing.
Check that selecting a country updates the phone number prefix in the Registration form.
Check that the Phone number field validates the entered value according to the selected country format.
Check that invalid phone number formats display a validation error message.
Check that the numeric keyboard is displayed when focusing the Phone number field.
Email Field
Check that the Email field is required on the Registration screen.
Check that the Email field validates entered email format correctly.
Check that invalid email values display a validation error message.
Check that valid email values enable successful form validation.
Check that validation errors are cleared dynamically after correcting invalid email values.
Preferred Notification Channel
Check that only one preferred notification channel option can be selected at a time.
Check that the user can select SMS as the preferred notification channel.
Check that the user can select Email as the preferred notification channel.
Check that the selected preferred notification channel remains selected while editing other form fields.
Check that the selected preferred notification channel is sent correctly in the registration request payload.
SMS Consent Logic
Check that tapping the SMS consent checkbox opens the “SMS Messaging Terms & Conditions” screen.
Check that the SMS Messaging Terms & Conditions screen displays the close icon, title, and legal content.
Check that the SMS Messaging Terms & Conditions screen displays the “I Accept SMS Terms & Conditions” button.
Check that tapping “I Accept SMS Terms & Conditions” closes the Terms screen and marks the SMS checkbox as selected.
Check that tapping the close icon on the Terms screen closes the screen without selecting the SMS checkbox.
Check that the SMS consent checkbox state persists after returning from the Terms screen.
Check that the SMS consent checkbox can be deselected after acceptance if allowed by business logic.
Check that the Continue button remains disabled if SMS notification channel is selected but SMS consent is not accepted.
Check that OTP-related SMS consent text is displayed correctly below the checkbox.
Continue Action & Registration Flow
Check that the Continue button becomes enabled only when all required fields contain valid values.
Check that tapping Continue submits registration data to the backend.
Check that successful registration navigates the user to the correct OTP verification flow based on the selected notification channel.
Check that selecting SMS notification channel opens the Phone number verification screen after successful registration.
Check that selecting Email notification channel opens the Email address verification screen after successful registration.
Check that multiple rapid taps on Continue do not trigger duplicate registration requests.
Check that entered form values remain preserved if registration fails.
Check that the error message “An account with this phone number already exists. Please log in to continue.” is displayed for already registered phone numbers.
Check that a generic error message is displayed when registration fails due to backend or network issues.
Check that the user can retry registration after an error without reopening the Registration screen.
General & Layout
Check that the Phone number verification screen displays the verified phone number in masked or formatted form.
Check that the Email address verification screen displays the verified email address in masked or formatted form.
Check that the correct screen title is displayed based on verification type.
Check that the correct instruction text is displayed based on verification type.
Check that four OTP input boxes are displayed on the verification screen.
Check that the Verify button is disabled until all four OTP digits are entered.
Check that the “Request a new code” option is disabled while the countdown timer is active.
Check that the “Request a new code” option becomes enabled after the countdown timer expires.
Check that the countdown timer value decreases correctly in real time.
OTP Input Behavior
Check that entering a digit automatically moves focus to the next OTP input field.
Check that deleting a digit moves focus back to the previous OTP input field.
Check that only numeric values are accepted in OTP input fields.
Check that more than four OTP digits cannot be entered.
Check that pasting OTP values fills the OTP fields correctly if supported.
Check that the numeric keyboard is displayed automatically when focusing OTP fields.
Verification Flow
Check that tapping Verify submits the entered OTP for backend validation.
Check that successful OTP verification authenticates the user successfully.
Check that successful OTP verification navigates the user to the Jobs screen or onboarding flow.
Check that incorrect OTP values display an “Incorrect code” validation error.
Check that OTP fields remain editable after invalid OTP verification attempts.
Check that multiple rapid taps on Verify do not trigger duplicate OTP validation requests.
Check that requesting a new OTP invalidates the previously issued OTP code.
Check that tapping “Request a new code” sends a new OTP to the selected delivery channel.
Check that requesting a new code restarts the countdown timer.
Check that the verification flow works correctly for both SMS and Email delivery channels.
Navigation & Error Handling
Check that tapping the back arrow returns the user to the previous authentication screen.
Check that OTP verification handles slow network responses without UI freezes or duplicated states.
Check that a generic error message is displayed if OTP verification fails due to connectivity issues.
Check that the user can retry OTP verification after network-related failures.
Check that OTP retry limits are enforced if configured by backend rules.
Check that OTP state is preserved or reset correctly after reopening the verification screen according to business logic.
General & Layout
Check that the Login screen is displayed when the user taps “Log in” from the Welcome screen.
Check that the Login screen displays the logo, title “Log in”, and subtitle “Good to see you! Let’s get you logged in.”
Check that the Login screen displays helper text instructing the user to enter email or phone number used during registration.
Check that the Login screen displays a single “Phone number / Email” input field.
Check that the Continue button is disabled when the input field is empty.
Check that the Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions links are displayed below the Continue button.
Check that the “Don’t have an account yet? Sign up” link is displayed at the bottom of the Login screen.
Input Validation
Check that the Login field accepts valid email addresses.
Check that the Login field accepts valid phone numbers.
Check that invalid email or phone number formats display the “Format is incorrect.” validation message.
Check that validation styling is displayed for invalid Login field values.
Check that validation errors are removed after correcting invalid input values.
Check that the Continue button becomes enabled only when a valid email or phone number is entered.
Login Flow
Check that tapping Continue with a valid registered phone number triggers OTP generation via SMS.
Check that tapping Continue with a valid registered email triggers OTP generation via Email.
Check that login with a registered phone number navigates to the Phone number verification screen.
Check that login with a registered email navigates to the Email address verification screen.
Check that multiple rapid taps on Continue do not trigger duplicate login requests.
Check that entered login values remain preserved if login fails.
Check that the error message “This phone number is not registered yet. Create an account to get started.” is displayed for unregistered phone numbers.
Check that the error message “This email is not registered yet. Create an account to get started.” is displayed for unregistered email addresses.
Check that a generic error message is displayed if login fails due to backend or network issues.
Check that the user can retry login without reopening the Login screen after a failed request.
Check that authenticated-only screens remain inaccessible without successful OTP verification.
General & Entry Logic
Check that the Orders List screen is displayed as the primary landing screen after successful login and authentication.
Check that the Orders List screen is opened when a registered user accesses the app via a valid job access link.
Check that the Orders List screen is not displayed for unauthenticated users and authentication flow is triggered instead.
Assigned to a Different Phone Number — Error Modal
Check that an error modal with the title “Assigned to a Different Phone Number” is displayed when a user opens a job link not linked to their phone number.
Check that the error modal displays explanatory text instructing the user to log out and sign in with the correct phone number.
Check that the error modal displays both “Cancel” and “Log out” action buttons.
Check that tapping “Cancel” closes the modal without logging the user out.
Check that tapping “Log out” logs the user out and navigates them to the authentication flow.
Layout & Navigation
Check that the top app bar is displayed on the Orders List screen with a calendar icon.
Check that tapping the calendar icon switches the view from List view to Calendar weekly view. (placeholder if Calendar view is implemented later)
Check that the bottom navigation bar is displayed on the Orders List screen.
Check that the Orders tab is highlighted as active in the bottom navigation bar.
Check that the Orders List screen remains accessible at all times via the bottom navigation bar.
Check that status filter buttons “New”, “In Progress”, and “Completed” are displayed on the Orders List screen.
Order List & Cards
Check that a list of order cards is displayed when orders are available for the authenticated user.
Check that each order card displays the Job ID as the primary bold element.
Check that each order card displays the Site Name for the order.
Check that each order card displays the City and State location information.
Check that each order card displays the scheduled date and scheduled time.
Check that each order card displays a visually distinct order status badge (e.g., New, In Progress).
Check that special indicators such as “Unsubmitted” are displayed on the order card when applicable.
Check that special indicators such as “Updated” are displayed on the order card when applicable.
Check that order status badges and indicators remain readable across different screen sizes.
Check that tapping an order card navigates the user to the corresponding Order Details screen.
Check that only a single navigation event is triggered when an order card is tapped multiple times rapidly.
Empty State
Check that an empty state is displayed when no orders are assigned to the user.
Check that the empty state displays a placeholder illustration or icon.
Check that the empty state displays the title text “No orders”.
Check that the empty state displays an informational message explaining that no orders are currently assigned.
Check that orders assigned via a valid access link appear in the Orders List after synchronization.
Check that cached orders are displayed on the Orders List screen when the device is offline and cached data exists.
Check that the Orders List screen displays an appropriate message or indicator when no cached data is available offline. (placeholder for UX decision)
Check that an error message is displayed when the orders list fails to load due to a network error.
Check that the user is able to retry loading the Orders List after a network error occurs.
Check that the Orders List screen recovers correctly after connectivity is restored.
Check that the Orders List screen does not display duplicate orders after refresh or navigation events.
Calendar (Weekly) View
General & Navigation
Check that the Calendar (Weekly) view is displayed when the user switches from the Orders List view using the calendar control.
Check that the Calendar (Weekly) view is accessible only to authenticated users.
Check that the bottom navigation bar remains visible with the Orders tab highlighted while the Calendar view is active.
Check that the user can switch back from the Calendar (Weekly) view to the Orders List view using the list control.
Check that the current month and year are displayed in the date selector section of the Calendar view.
Check that the default selected date is today when today falls within the current displayed week.
Check that the first day of the week is selected by default when today does not fall within the current week.
Check that the days of the selected week (Sunday to Saturday) are displayed in the date selector.
Check that the selected date is visually highlighted in the week selector.
Check that days containing scheduled orders are visually indicated in the week selector.
Check that tapping the previous week arrow navigates to the previous calendar week.
Check that tapping the next week arrow navigates to the next calendar week.
Check that orders are displayed only for the currently selected date in the Calendar (Weekly) view.
Check that the order list updates immediately when a different date is selected.
Check that the Calendar view displays order cards using the same layout and elements as the Orders List view.
Check that each order card displays the Job ID as the primary identifier.
Check that each order card displays the Site Name and City, State information.
Check that each order card displays the scheduled start date and time.
Check that each order card displays the order status badge (New or In Progress).
Check that special flags such as “Updated” or “Unsubmitted” are displayed on order cards when applicable.
Check that only orders with status New or In Progress are displayed in the Calendar (Weekly) view.
Check that tapping an order card in the Calendar view navigates the user to the corresponding Order Details screen.
Check that multiple rapid taps on an order card do not trigger duplicate navigation events.
Check that an empty state is displayed when no orders are scheduled for the selected date.
Check that the empty state displays the title text “No orders”.
Check that the empty state displays informational text explaining that no orders exist for the selected date.
Check that the empty state is shown instead of an empty list when no orders are available for the selected date.
Check that cached calendar and order data is displayed when the device is offline and cached data exists.
Check that the Calendar (Weekly) view displays an appropriate state when offline and no cached data is available. (placeholder for UX decision)
Check that switching between weeks does not cause UI flickering or layout shifts.
Check that the Calendar (Weekly) view handles a large number of orders without performance degradation.
Check that the selected date and order list state are preserved when switching between Calendar and List views.
Details main screen_General & Layout
Check that the Order Details screen is displayed when the user selects an order from the Orders List or Calendar view.
Check that the back navigation arrow returns the user to the previous screen without losing state.
Check that the Order ID is displayed prominently in the header of the Order Details screen.
Check that the order title is displayed below the Order ID.
Check that the current order status badge (e.g., New, In Progress) is clearly visible.
Check that the “Updated” indicator is displayed when the order content has changed since last viewed.
Check that the “Updated” indicator disappears after the user navigates away from the Order Details screen.
Check that the order description and scope of work are displayed as readable multi-line instructions.
Check that all order information sections are visually separated by dividers.
Check that all order information fields are read-only and cannot be edited by the user.
Location & Map
Check that the full job site address is displayed in the Location section.
Check that tapping the “On map” link opens the job location in an in-app map view or external maps application.
Check that the map opens with the correct job site coordinates.
Date & Time
Check that the scheduled start date and time are displayed with visual date and time icons.
Check that the displayed date and time reflect the latest scheduled values received from the backend.
PF Information
Check that the PF name is displayed in the PF Info section.
Check that tapping the PF phone number opens the device dialer with the number prefilled.
Attachments Navigation
Check that the Attachments section is displayed on the Order Details screen.
Check that tapping the Attachments section navigates the user to the Order Attachments screen.
Primary Action — Check In
Check that the Check In button is displayed at the bottom of the screen when the order status is New or not started.
Check that the Check In button is always visible and accessible without scrolling.
Check that tapping the Check In button initiates the check-in workflow.
Location Permissions & GPS Logic
Check that the Enable Location Services prompt is displayed before requesting OS-level location permission.
Check that the prompt clearly explains why location access is required.
Check that tapping Enable triggers the operating system location permission dialog.
Check that tapping Cancel dismisses the prompt and continues the check-in flow without GPS.
Check that the Location Disabled prompt is displayed when device-level location services are turned off.
Check that tapping Go to settings opens the device location settings screen.
Check that tapping Cancel returns the user to the check-in flow without GPS validation.
Check that the system captures the user’s GPS location when GPS is enabled during check-in.
Check that the system compares the captured GPS location with the registered job site location.
Check that a Check-in Location Mismatch alert is displayed when the distance exceeds the allowed tolerance threshold (~100 meters).
Check that the Check-in Location Mismatch alert explains that the user is not at the registered job site.
Check that tapping Got it closes the alert and returns the user to the previous screen.
Check that tapping Cancel dismisses the alert without completing check-in.
Manual Check-In
Check that a manual location entry prompt is displayed when GPS coordinates cannot be obtained.
Check that the manual location input field allows the user to enter a textual location.
Check that tapping Confirm saves the manually entered location to the order.
Check that manual check-ins are clearly marked as manual in order data.
Check that manual check-ins do not block job execution.
Data Recording
Check that a notification is displayed when location data cannot be retrieved due to system or sensor error.
Check that the order is marked with a flag indicating GPS was not confirmed when automatic location fails.
Check that location permission failures do not prevent the user from continuing the job.
Check that the check-in records include the method used (GPS or Manual).
Check that the check-in records include captured coordinates when GPS is available.
Check that the check-in records include horizontal accuracy values when GPS is used.
Check that the check-in records include an accurate timestamp of the action.
Check that cached order details are displayed when the device is offline.
Check that the Check In flow can be initiated offline and synchronized later when connectivity is restored. (placeholder if async sync is planned)
Check that the Order Details screen remains responsive during slow GPS or network conditions.
Attachments screen
General & Layout
Check that the Attachments screen is displayed when the user selects the Attachments section from the Order Details screen.
Check that the Attachments screen header displays a back navigation control that returns the user to the Order Details screen.
Check that the screen title “Attachments” is displayed at the top of the Attachments screen.
Check that the tab selector displays two tabs: Documents and Photos.
Check that the Documents tab is selected by default when the Attachments screen is opened.
Attachment Listing
Check that all attachments associated with the selected order are displayed on the Attachments screen.
Check that document files are displayed only under the Documents tab.
Check that photo files are displayed only under the Photos tab.
Check that switching between Documents and Photos tabs updates the content area accordingly.
Documents Tab
Check that each document item displays the file name including its extension (e.g., “Safety instruction.pdf”).
Check that the document file type is visually identifiable via the file extension or indicator.
Check that tapping a document item opens the document in an in-app document viewer.
Document Viewer
Check that the document opens in a full-screen document viewer.
Check that the document viewer supports vertical scrolling for multi-page documents.
Check that the document viewer supports zoom in and zoom out gestures.
Check that the document viewer provides read-only access to the document content.
Check that a Close (X) control is displayed in the document viewer.
Check that tapping the Close (X) control returns the user to the Documents list.
Check that the user is able to save a document locally when permitted by the operating system.
Check that a success toast or banner is displayed when a document is successfully saved to the device.
Check that supported document formats include PDF, DOC, and XLS.
Check that unsupported document formats are handled gracefully with an appropriate message. (placeholder for future formats)
Photos Tab
Check that the Photos tab displays a grid layout of photo thumbnails.
Check that all photo thumbnails have consistent sizing and spacing in the grid.
Check that tapping a photo thumbnail opens the photo in a full-screen photo viewer.
Photo Viewer
Check that the selected photo is displayed in full-screen mode in the photo viewer.
Check that the photo viewer supports pinch-to-zoom gestures.
Check that the photo viewer supports panning gestures when zoomed.
Check that a Close (X) control is displayed in the photo viewer.
Check that tapping the Close (X) control returns the user to the Photos grid.
Check that previously downloaded documents are accessible when the device is offline.
Check that previously downloaded photos are accessible when the device is offline.
Check that the system notifies the user when attempting to open an attachment that is not available offline.
Check that the Attachments screen displays an appropriate message when attachment loading fails due to a network error.
Check that the user is able to retry loading attachments after a network failure.
Check that switching between Documents and Photos tabs does not cause UI flickering or layout shifts.
Check that opening and closing attachments does not reset the selected tab unexpectedly.
Check that the Attachments screen remains responsive when a large number of documents or photos are present.
Check that attachment content is cached for subsequent access according to offline behavior rules.
Entry & Modal Presentation
Check that the Check-In Confirmation screen is displayed as a full-screen modal when the user initiates a check-in action from the Order Details screen.
Check that the Check-Out Confirmation screen is displayed as a full-screen modal when the user initiates a check-out action from an In Progress order.
Check that the confirmation modal displays a Close (X) icon that cancels the action.
Check that the confirmation modal displays a clear title indicating Check-In or Check-Out action.
Check that the confirmation modal displays a primary message describing the action being confirmed.
Check that the confirmation modal displays supporting explanatory text clarifying the effect of the action.
Action Buttons & Cancellation
Check that the Cancel button aborts the check-in action and closes the confirmation modal without changing the order status.
Check that the Cancel button aborts the check-out action and closes the confirmation modal without changing the order status.
Check that tapping the Close (X) icon behaves the same as tapping Cancel.
Check that tapping Confirm on the Check-In screen records the check-in timestamp.
Check that tapping Confirm on the Check-In screen triggers GPS capture when location permission is enabled.
Check that the check-in method is flagged as GPS when location is successfully captured.
Check that the check-in method is flagged as Manual when GPS is unavailable or declined.
Check that the order status is updated to In Progress after successful check-in confirmation.
Check that an email notification is triggered to the Project Facilitator after a successful check-in.
Check that tapping Confirm on the Check-Out screen records the check-out timestamp.
Check that tapping Confirm on the Check-Out screen triggers GPS capture when location permission is enabled.
Check that the check-out method is flagged as GPS when location is successfully captured.
Check that the check-out method is flagged as Manual when GPS is unavailable or declined.
Check that the order status is updated to Completed or the next workflow status after successful check-out.
Check that an email notification is triggered to the Project Facilitator after a successful check-out.
Location Integration
Check that initiating Check-In triggers the location permission and validation flow defined in the Location Services specification.
Check that initiating Check-Out triggers the location permission and validation flow defined in the Location Services specification.
Check that manual Check-In or Check-Out is allowed when GPS permission is denied or location is unavailable.
Check that manual Check-In action іs clearly flagged in the recorded data.
Check that manual Check-Out action is clearly flagged in the recorded data.
Error Handling & Retry
Check that an error message is displayed if the Check-In operation fails due to a system or network error.
Check that an error message is displayed if the Check-Out operation fails due to a system or network error.
Check that the user is allowed to retry Check-In after a failed Check-In attempt.
Check that the user is allowed to retry Check-Out after a failed Check-Out attempt.
Check that the Check-In action does not complete if required data such as timestamp cannot be recorded.
Check that the Check-Out action does not complete if required data such as timestamp cannot be recorded.
Data Integrity
Check that each Check-In event stores the correct Order ID and User ID.
Check that each Check-Out event stores the correct Order ID and User ID.
Check that the recorded action type is correctly stored as Check-In or Check-Out.
Check that the recorded timestamp reflects the actual confirmation time of the action.
Check that GPS coordinates are stored when location is enabled and available.
UX & Stability
Check that the confirmation modal remains responsive during slow GPS acquisition or network conditions.
Check that multiple rapid taps on the Confirm button do not trigger duplicate Check-In or Check-Out events.
Check that the user cannot initiate Check-In or Check-Out actions that are invalid for the current order status.
Header & Status
Check that the Order Details screen displays the “In progress” status badge when the job is active.
Check that the elapsed time counter is displayed in HH:MM:SS format and updates in real time on the In Progress screen.
Check that the elapsed time counter continues correctly after the app is minimized and reopened while the job remains In Progress.
Deliverables Section UI
Check that the Deliverables section displays three tappable items: Survey, Photo report, and Notes.
Check that each deliverable row displays an icon and a navigation chevron indicating it is tappable.
Check that tapping Survey navigates to the Survey data entry screen from the In Progress screen.
Check that tapping Photo report navigates to the Photo report data entry screen from the In Progress screen.
Check that tapping Notes navigates to the Notes data entry screen from the In Progress screen.
Check that each deliverable displays a completion state indicator in the In Progress list when progress exists. (placeholder if indicator is added later)
Order Information Section UI
Check that the job scope text is displayed as multi-line instructions under the deliverables section.
Check that the Location section displays site name and City, State information on the In Progress screen.
Check that the “On map” link is displayed in the Location section and is tappable.
Check that tapping “On map” opens an external maps application with the correct job site location.
Check that the Date & time section displays the scheduled date and time in the format shown in the design.
Check that the PF info section displays the PF name and a tappable phone number link.
Check that tapping the PF phone number opens the device dialer with the number prefilled.
Check that the Attachments row is displayed and navigates to the Attachments screen when tapped.
Submit Deliverables Button & Confirmation
Check that the primary action button displays “Submit deliverables” when deliverables are not yet submitted and the job is In Progress.
Check that tapping “Submit deliverables” displays a confirmation modal titled “Submit deliverables”.
Check that the confirmation modal informs the user they won’t be able to edit deliverables after submission.
Check that the confirmation modal displays both Cancel and Submit actions.
Check that tapping Cancel closes the confirmation modal without submitting deliverables.
Check that tapping Submit triggers deliverables submission to the backend and prevents further edits to deliverables.
Submission Progress & Success States
Check that a “Submitting deliverables” progress state is displayed while submission is in progress.
Check that the Submit deliverables button is disabled while submission is in progress.
Check that a success toast “Deliverables sent to review successfully” is displayed after successful submission.
Check that the primary action area displays a success state label (e.g., “Successful”) after submission completes.
Check that the primary action button changes to “Check out” after deliverables are successfully submitted.
Offline / Poor Connection Behavior
Check that the Submit deliverables button is disabled when the device is offline on the In Progress screen.
Check that an offline informational message is displayed when the device is offline and submission is unavailable. (placeholder if text differs from SRS)
Check that deliverables progress is saved locally while offline and remains available after app restart.
Check that deliverables are automatically synced or submitted when connectivity is restored if submission was interrupted.
Connection Restored Modal
Check that a “Connection restored” modal is displayed when network connectivity returns and there are unfinished jobs with pending submission.
Check that the “Connection restored” modal lists the unfinished job name(s) and identifiers as shown in the wireframes.
Check that the “Connection restored” modal provides Cancel and Submit actions.
Check that tapping Cancel closes the modal without submitting pending deliverables.
Check that tapping Submit starts deliverables submission for the listed unfinished job(s).
Check that an error message is displayed when deliverables submission fails due to network or server error.
Check that the user can retry submission after a deliverables submission failure without losing entered data.
Check that locally stored deliverables are preserved and retried automatically when syncing fails due to connectivity issues.
Check that deliverables cannot be edited after successful submission if the confirmation warning is accepted.
Check that returning to the In Progress screen preserves the correct primary action state based on submission status.
Pop-up Display & UI
